title: Inflation and oil end the winning run: Nifty falls 155 points to 25,144 as realty, autos and metals slide
short: Inflation and oil end the run; Nifty falls 155 pts to 25,144
dek: The first session after October's 6.09% inflation print ended with the Nifty down 0.61% and the Sensex at 81,592.45. Brent climbed back above $95 and the rupee slipped to 94.20, but foreign investors kept buying.
sources: HDFC Sky: Market close report, 13 November 2026
Business Standard: Stock market live, 13 November 2026
Telangana Today (PTI): Strong dollar, weak equities drag rupee down to 94.20
